Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary parent, molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary child, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join parent to molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno. Join molecule_hierarchy to child on molregno = child.molregno. Join child to compound_structures on molregno. Join child to compound_records on molregno. Join compound_records to docs on doc_id. Join compound_records to activities on record_id. Join activities to assays on assay_id. Join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3182437'. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3430885'. Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
